newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys Jan-Feb reformate at around $27/bls.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys Jan-Feb reformate at around $27/bls.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) is to buy by tender 250,000 barrels each of leaded and unleaded 95-octane reformate at around $27.00 per barrel, a company official said on Tuesday.
The official said the awards will be finalised late Tuesday as it has yet to be officially approved.
The unleaded cargo will be awarded at around $27.00 while the leaded was slightly more expensive due to high freight costs for the leaded cargo.

The tender which closes December 30 and is valid for two days, sought a leaded cargo for delivery January 28-February 3 and the unleaded for February 11-28. Both cargoes were awarded on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis for delivery to Keelung or Taichung.

CPC's last purchase was cheaper. It paid $26.20 per barrel for a 250,000-barrel unleaded cargo for delivery January 18-27 from a European major and another from a Dutch trader for February 11-20 delivery at $25.75 per barrel, both on a c-and-f basis.
